run_f_gold: run f_gold to count ways a boolean expression with symbols and operators evaluates to true
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using parameterized test cases for boolean parenthesization
summarize_f_gold: summarize the dynamic programming approach f_gold uses to solve the boolean parenthesization problem
review_f_gold: review f_gold for correctness of the DP recurrence for AND OR and XOR operators
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use named variables and clearer DP table indexing for readability
